Resolutions of 1950

11 resolutions, 0% unanimous. Founding and early Cold War.

  • 79 (1950) Regulation and general reduction of conventional armaments and armed forces
  • 80 (1950) Deciding to appoint a UN Representative for India and Pakistan and to terminate the UN Commission for India and Pakistan
  • 81 (1950) Appointment of a rapporteur or conciliator for a situation or dispute brought to the attention of the Security Council
  • 82 (1950) Calling upon the North Korean authorities to withdraw their armed forces to the 38th parallel
  • 83 (1950) Assistance to the Republic of Korea
  • 84 (1950) The Korean question and a unified command under the United States
  • 85 (1950) International relief for Korea
  • 86 (1950) Admission of Indonesia to membership in the United Nations
  • 87 (1950) Complaint of armed invasion of Taiwan
  • 88 (1950) Inviting the People's Republic of China to be present during discussion of the special report on the UN Command in Korea
  • 89 (1950) Implementation of the armistice agreements between Jordan and Israel, and Israel and Egypt
